newsitem.title: UK: INTERVIEW-UK's Natl Grid confirms job cuts.
newsitem.headline: INTERVIEW-UK's Natl Grid confirms job cuts.

text.p: British electricity transmission network National Grid Group Plc confirmed on Tuesday it planned to cut about 750 jobs over the next four years as part of its cost-reduction programme. Finance director John Uttley told Reuters in an interview that the company currently had a workforce equivalent to about 4,413 jobs, including 3,870 at its main businesses and 543 at its Energis telecommunications service.

The company also planned to cut costs by spending less on contractors and improving procurement, he added. "We're not a company that's going to manage by headcount. We're a company that's going to manage by our overall cost base," he said.
Uttley added that the firm was in talks with possible partners for Energis, which posted increased turnover in the first half. He declined to identify the companies.
"We have been talking about bringing in partners, with us still retaining a strong stake in it," he said.
Last summer, the company said it would take about 12 months to find a partner. "I don't know that we would want to change that timetable," Uttley said.
National Grid's shares firmed 1.0p to 200 at 0955 GMT.
